title: Attachments: a member cannot attach a file to their own record (create_upload_link attachments:true answers 403 "cannot create sys_attachment"), though they can edit the record
body:
domain:server#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWRcTEB3toGxnWvuvX

Ruled: 6837170004 · letter B · 2026-11-12T22:03Z

Filing category: ① product defect.
reach: public entry `/api/v1/mcp` `create_upload_link`, measured on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`, Team plan; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`), with a member's and the owner's MCP OAuth tokens, twice (two apps, a day apart).

## Business reason

"Attach the receipt / the contract / the photo to my request" is the most common file action an employee takes. On a record they own and can edit, they are told they lack permission.

## What happens

Record `ebqu_claim/W7rSVhWT5NV0pOfj`, owned by the member, status draft, editable by them (`update_record` succeeds; `create_upload_link { field: 'invoices' }` succeeds and the upload lands):
- member: `create_upload_link { objectName: 'ebqu_claim', recordId, attachments: true }` → `403 PERMISSION_DENIED — You cannot attach files: your permissions do not allow creating attachments (sys_attachment).`
- owner, same record → link issued.

The member's access comes from the app's member permission set (AI-built, granted to everyone from Studio › 权限); it grants the app's object, not `sys_attachment`. The same refusal was measured on an earlier app (`k7en_claim`).

## Expected

Attaching to a record follows the record: a user who may edit the record may attach to it (the delete side already reasons from the parent, #21729 / #22455), or the app member permission set carries attachment create. Either way, the member's own draft takes an attachment.

Reader who acts: the attachments/storage seat (`attachFileAs` gate) or the security seat (default grants), whichever owns the posture.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue member attachment sys_attachment create own record` → 57 hits (#32686 open, cites this refusal as evidence only; #21729 and #22455 closed, delete side and the sharing gate) — none on create for a member.
